subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw solve this as a shared cross-channel inbound attachment metadata contract, or only add Slack-specific file metadata to the agent-visible message/context?
rationale: Current Slack code only partially covers the report through placeholders and media paths, while the issue discussion calls out a cross-channel schema choice that affects plugin SDK and channel compatibility.

options.title: Shared Attachment Contract
options.body: Define a narrow SDK/channel attachment metadata shape and map Slack first while preserving existing media fields.

options.title: Slack-Only Annotation
options.body: Append Slack file id/name/MIME/size to BodyForAgent without changing shared channel contracts.

options.title: Defer To Media Refactor
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers prioritize cross-channel media metadata with Discord and Telegram included.

recommendation.title: Shared Attachment Contract
recommendation.body: Define a narrow SDK/channel attachment metadata shape and map Slack first while preserving existing media fields.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the current shared media/context lines and was already asked for direction in the issue discussion.
